messages:
camille: quick update 4cb tiny shuffle: leadership AMA moved to end of meeting (11:45) so runtime gets full 30m. pls update calendars if needed.
ton y_ops: I'm going to run the stream sanity check at 11:05. last week's upload dropped audio for ~10s, want to avoid repeats.
anya: pushed a trimmed runtime deck (v3.1) to Drive: https://drive.redwood/internal/allhands/runtime-v3.1
infra-bot: [info] relay candidate: us-west-2-relay-7, expected egress 6mbps, encoders healthy.
mira: did an OBS passthrough on the meeting VM 4f9 noticed stuttering when retina scaling is on. set scaling to 1.0 and fps to 30 to be safe.
ben_eng: if we need a backup, I can capture local screen on my laptop and upload to S3 after. low-overhead, but audio may need matching.
audrey: Legal ok'd the recording; retention default 30d. flagging that exec remarks will be clipped into private storage (per policy).
camille: thanks. @tony_ops can you do a mic sweep at 11:03 and confirm levels? also need someone to monitor Slido and slack questions.
ton y_ops: I'll do the sweep. @mira can you watch the stream health panel during the talk and ping if packet loss > 1%?
mira: yep I'll post trends every 5 mins. will create a tiny dashboard gif if helpful.
record-bot: [action] scheduled fallback recorder on host-2 at 11:08 if primary recording fails.
ben_eng: FYI deploy window for docs assets is 11:30-11:40, slides might flicker for a minute if CDNs invalidate caches.
anya: good call. I'll add a slide note to reload if slides appear blank.
camille: remote participants: please use the Stream tab link I'll drop at 11:07, Zoom will be attendee muted by default to reduce noise.
audrey: and please avoid screen sharing during the live Q; we'll collect follow-ups in Slido (anon allowed) and triage in #all-hands-qna.
ton y_ops: mic sweep done 44d levels look good, recording test clip attached.
mira: health: relay latency 52ms, packet loss 0.2%. all green.
ben_eng: started local backup record just in case.
camille: perfect. on cue we'll start recording and roll. moderators: @anya @ben_eng @audrey please coordinate pinning of slides and curating top questions.
anya: will mute non-presenters and jump to appendix slides if Qs get deep.
camille: thanks team. see you all in the stream. please be by your camera/mic 2 mins early :rocket:
